source_delta: B full-mode pins repository arguments in fetch/comment examples and paginates the REST fallback.

source_and_producer_findings.publication_predicate: The helper checks selected host/base PR identity and actual head repository/ref, then compares the exact fix SHA against the observed head SHA in the head repository. Only ahead/identical plus merge base equal to fix passes.
source_and_producer_findings.original_producer: prepare-pr-feedback.cjs imports B's actual helper and supplies an in-process read stub. Its original unpublished stub deliberately or accidentally combines behind with the fix as merge base; retain only its rejection result.
source_and_producer_findings.supplement_reproduction: The reproduction source and stored results consistently use the remote head as merge base, preserve expected endpoints and match original supplement results apart from observed_at. This reviewer did not rerun reproduction.
source_and_producer_findings.A_receipt_wording: The generic actual-pure-helper limitation is broader than A's concrete result. A has no such helper and no supplemental calls; all six artifacts avoid promoting this wording into A execution evidence.
source_and_producer_findings.trial_read_boundary: All observed commands read assigned-arm frozen source and named evidence. No opposite-arm, earlier-trial artifact, grader, current runtime or unrelated canonical source reads were observed in the original trial traces.
